name: Imprint X
summary: An event-driven visuotactile sensor for robot fingertips and grippers. It uses a miniature independent event camera to output raw events, a 2D displacement field and a 3D tactile-deformation point cloud. The manufacturer announced the product and opened preorders on September 7, 2026.
